environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS with IRSA. The pod service account is bound to an IAM role whose DynamoDB permission includes leading-key condition constraints via dynamodb:LeadingKeys and a StringEquals condition on dynamodb:LeadingKeys matching ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}. The role's trust policy sets the tenant_id principal tag from the OIDC token claim 'custom:tenant'. Additionally, the IAM policy includes a Deny statement with condition StringNotEquals on dynamodb:LeadingKeys vs the tagged tenant, ensuring cross-tenant GetItem calls return AccessDenied regardless of the partition key supplied in the request. The gRPC upstream service runs with an Envoy sidecar (Istio mesh) that strips any metadata header matching the pattern 'x-ctx-*' or 'x-route-*' before forwarding to the application container, configured via EnvoyFilter resource with operation REMOVE for request headers matching the regex '^x-(ctx|route)-'. The Istio AuthorizationPolicy requires a valid JWT with matching tenant claim before allowing traffic to the user-service pod.
